;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[October 2020 Afghanistan attacks]]
***At least 13 people, including ten [[Afghan soldier]]s, are killed and another three injured in a [[roadside bomb]]ing attack in [[Sar-e Pol Province]]. [https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-166960 (TOLOnews)]
*[[Second Nagorno-Karabakh War]]
**[[Azerbaijan]] says an [[Armenia]]n missile strike on its second-largest city [[Ganja, Azerbaijan|Ganja]] has destroyed a residential apartment building, killing nine people and injuring dozens of others. Armenia rejects reports of the strike. Blasts are also heard in [[Stepanakert]] as clashes resume in [[Nagorno-Karabakh]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-54488386 (BBC News)] [https://caspiannews.com/news-detail/armenia-violates-ceasefire-by-hitting-second-largest-azerbaijani-city-9-civilians-killed-34-injured-2020-10-11-0/ (Caspian News)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**[[Insurgent]]s kill at least two [[Pakistani soldier]]s and injure three others in Manra Mendara, [[North Waziristan]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1584426/two-soldiers-martyred-in-waziristan-attack (''Dawn'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**Two people are reported to be dead following the aftermath of [[Hurricane Delta]] in [[Louisiana]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/10/12/weather/hurricane-delta-monday/index.html (CNN)] [https://globalnews.ca/news/7391645/louisiana-hurricane-relief/ (Global News)]
*[[List of explosions]]
**A gas explosion kills at least five people and injures another nine in [[Ahvaz]], [[Khuzestan Province]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-blast/gas-explosion-hits-market-kills-at-least-five-in-southwest-iran-idUSKBN26W068?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**A migrant boat capsizes off the coast of [[Tunisia]], killing at least 11 people, who were all women and children, according to the [[Tunisian Navy]]. Around 20 others are still missing. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-tunisia-migrants/at-least-11-die-as-migrant-boat-sinks-off-tunisia-idUKKBN26W0WJ?il=0 (Reuters)]
*A collision between a bus and a train kills 20 people and injures another in [[Thailand]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-crash/20-killed-on-temple-trip-in-thailand-as-bus-train-collide-idUSKBN26W092 (Reuters)]
*Floods kill at least two people in [[Cambodia]] and five in [[Vietnam]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/10/11/deadly-floods-displace-thousands-in-cambodia-vietnam (Al Jazeera)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)]]
****The COVID-19 infection rate in [[New York (state)|New York]] drops to its lowest in two weeks for the first time since September 24. However, the state continues to battle COVID-19 clusters in [[Hasidic Judaism|Hasidic Jewish]] communities in [[Orange County, New York|Orange County]], [[Rockland County, New York|Rockland County]], [[Brooklyn]], and several areas in the [[Queens]] borough. [https://www.nny360.com/news/publicservicenews/covid-infections-in-new-york-dip-to-lowest-rate-since-september/article_dc2e7775-f0ee-50bf-b2af-c1223af73b61.html (NNY360.com)] [https://www.newsday.com/news/health/coronavirus/coronavirus-gov-andrew-m-cuomo-1.50034029 (''Newsday'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Florida]]
****[[Florida]]'s [[Florida Department of Health|Department of Health]] reports 5,570 additional COVID-19 cases, the highest number of reported cases in a single day since August. It comes a day after Florida did not report any new cases or deaths because officials were left combing through 400,000 test results a private lab resent Friday night. [https://www.miamiherald.com/news/coronavirus/article246375675.html (''Miami Herald'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kentucky]]
****[[Governor of Kentucky|Kentucky governor]] [[Andy Beshear]] and his family enter [[quarantine]] after a member of his security detail who drove with his family tested positive for COVID-19. [https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/520555-kentucky-governor-to-quarantine-with-family-after-coronavirus-exposure (''The Hill'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Colorado]]
****[[Governor of Colorado|Colorado Governor]] [[Jared Polis]] extends the statewide [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|mask mandate]] for 30 days. [https://www.kktv.com/2020/10/09/colorado-governor-says-he-plans-to-extend-mask-order-for-a-3rd-time/ (KKTV-TV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
****[[California]] reports 2,209 hospitalizations, the lowest in the state since April. [https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2020-10-12/californians-hospitalized-with-covid-19-lowest-level-in-6-months (''Los Angeles Times'')] [https://www.mercurynews.com/coronavirus-california-hits-hospitalization-milestone-but-two-counties-provide-concern (''Mercury News'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kerala]]
*****The state of [[Kerala]] passes [[Maharashtra]] to become the state with most number of new COVID-19 cases, with 11,755 new cases being reported, the highest ever for the state. [https://indianexpress.com/article/explained/india-coronavirus-numbers-explained-oct-11-in-a-first-kerala-tops-even-maharashtra-6720633/ (The Indian Express)] 
****[[India]] surpasses seven million COVID-19 cumulative cases, becoming the second country to reach that milestone after the [[United States]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/indias-confirmed-coronavirus-cases-cross-million-73545912 (AP via ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****Two high-ranking [[Iran]]ian officials, [[Mohammad Bagher Nobakht]] and [[Ali Akbar Salehi]], test positive for COVID-19. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/coronavirus/2020/10/10/Coronavirus-in-Iran-Rouhani-adviser-Mohammad-Bagher-Nobakht-contracts-COVID-19 (Al Arabiya)]
****Iran announces its highest single-day death toll from the virus, with 251 confirmed deaths in the last 24 hours, the same day that the country surpasses 500,000 COVID-19 cases. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/iran-currency-slides-head-nuclear-body-contacts-virus-73546831 (AP via ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]], [[2020 Indonesia large-scale social restrictions]]
****It is announced that the [[Indonesia]]n capital [[Jakarta]] will restart its "transitional" eased [[2020 Indonesia large-scale social restrictions|large-scale social restrictions]] effective tomorrow, after a pace of infections has slowed within two weeks, according to a statement from the [[Governor of Jakarta|governor]] [[Anies Baswedan]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/worldNews/idUSKBN26W05V?il=0 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Lebanon]]
****The [[Ministry of Interior and Municipalities (Lebanon)|Interior Ministry]] ordered the closure of pubs, bars, nightclubs and amusement parks until further notice in a bid to curb the spread of COVID-19. In addition, 169 towns and village across [[Lebanon]] were put into a local lockdown, which will begin tomorrow at 6:00 a.m. local time. [http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Lebanon-News/2020/Oct-11/512938-lebanon-bars-to-close-169-towns-to-go-under-lockdown.ashx (''The Daily Star'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[Prime Minister of South Korea|Prime Minister]] [[Chung Sye-kyun]] announces that South Korea will begin easing [[social distancing]] rules from Level 2 to Level 1 nationwide tomorrow, allowing limited audiences at sporting events and the reopening of nightly entertainment facilities, as long as they comply with anti-virus health protocols, as new cases have been edging lower in recent weeks. However, some restrictions will be kept in place in [[Seoul Capital Area]] and other high-risk facilities. [https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2020/10/11/skorea-eases-social-distancing-curbs-amid-covid-19-downtrend.html (''The Jakarta Post'')] [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20201011002300315 (Yonhap News Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[Montpellier]] and [[Toulouse]] both announce maximum alert status for the city and their respective surrounding towns effective October 13, joining [[Paris]], [[Marseille]] and four other cities due to soaring cases and hospitalization in [[France]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/french-nurses-poll-paints-grim-picture-as-virus-cases-soar/2020/10/11/63b1fa4e-0bcc-11eb-b404-8d1e675ec701_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] reports 13 new deaths taking the nationwide total to 449, a new record since the beginning of the pandemic. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/257944/article/ekathimerini/news/13-coronavirus-deaths-are-a-new-daily-record (''Ekathimerini'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] registers 13,634 new cases in the last 24 hours, taking the cumulative nationwide total to 1,298,718, the fourth highest in the world. This marks a new record of confirmed cases in a single day since the first cases were confirmed in January. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/russia-registers-new-single-day-record-of-13634-covid-19-cases/articleshow/78602171.cms (''Times of India'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] is expected to test the [[BCG vaccine]] on frontline care workers to see if it's effective against COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-britain-bcg/uk-study-tests-if-bcg-vaccine-protects-against-covid-idUSL8N2H10H5 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
****[[Premier of Victoria|Victorian premier]] [[Daniel Andrews]] extends its [[state of emergency]] and state of disaster across the state for the next four weeks until November 8. [https://7news.com.au/lifestyle/health-wellbeing/premier-extends-victorias-state-of-emergency-and-state-of-disaster-c-1378697 (7 News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
****The [[New Zealand Government|government]] announces that they have signed a deal with [[Pfizer]] and [[BioNTech]] to purchase 1.5 million [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] doses for 750,000 people in the country. [https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/covid-19-coronavirus-nz-signs-on-to-buy-15-million-doses-of-vaccine/R7BPM2HZU7YW6Z2HWLJKVBSHUY/ (''New Zealand Herald'')]

;International relations
*[[Iran–United States relations]], [[Iranian intervention in Iraq (2014–present)|Iranian intervention in Iraq]]
**[[Kata'ib Hezbollah]], an [[Iran]]-backed militia, announces that they have agreed to ceasefire operations against [[United States]] interests in [[Iraq]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/iran-backed-militias-announce-conditional-cease-fire-against-us-in-iraq/2020/10/11/7a64f624-0bbd-11eb-b404-8d1e675ec701_story.html (''Washington Post'')]

;Law and crime
*[[2020 Belarusian protests]]
**Riot police in [[Belarus]] use [[water cannon]]s and stun grenades to break up mass protests against disputed [[President of Belarus|President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-54500555 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Lithuanian parliamentary election]]
**The first round of [[Elections in Lithuania|parliamentary elections]] in [[Lithuania]] takes place. Voters are asked to elect the 141 members of the [[Seimas]] amidst a rapid increase of [[COVID-19 pandemic in Lithuania|COVID-19 cases]], causing fears of a low voter turnout. [https://www.dw.com/en/lithuania-surging-covid-19-infections-overshadow-first-round-of-parliamentary-elections/a-55233998 (DW)]
*[[2020 Northern Cypriot presidential election]]
**Voters in [[Northern Cyprus]] vote to select the [[President of Northern Cyprus|president]] after being delayed for months due to [[COVID-19 pandemic in Northern Cyprus|the COVID-19 pandemic]]. The election council reports that nationalist [[Prime Minister of Northern Cyprus|Prime Minister]] [[Ersin Tatar]] narrowly defeated pro-reunification incumbent [[Mustafa Akıncı]]. As neither candidate received a majority of the vote, a [[Two-round system|run-off]] will be held on October 18. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/10/11/akinci-ankara-backed-tartar-go-into-turkish-cypriot-runoff (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2020 Tajik presidential election]]
**Voters in [[Tajikistan]] head to the polls to [[Elections in Tajikistan|elect]] the country's [[President of Tajikistan|President]]. Long-time [[authoritarian]] leader [[Emomali Rakhmon]] is highly expected to be declared the clear victor of the election. [https://www.dw.com/en/tajikistan-strongman-rakhmon-set-to-extend-28-year-rule/a-55235486 (DW)] 

;Sports
*[[2020 French Open]]
**[[Rafael Nadal]] of [[Spain]] defeats [[Novak Djokovic]] of [[Serbia]] in the final of the [[2020 French Open - Men's Singles|Men's Singles]] 6–0, 6–2, 7–5. With the win, Nadal equalled [[Roger Federer]]'s all-time record of 20 Grand Slam singles titles. [https://www.smh.com.au/sport/tennis/nadal-stuns-djokovic-in-french-open-final-to-equal-federer-s-record-20201012-p5643f.html (''The Sydney Morning Herald'')]
*[[2020 NBA Finals]]
**The [[Los Angeles Lakers]] win the [[2020 NBA Finals|NBA Finals]] following their 106–93 victory against the [[Miami Heat]] in game 6, bringing an end to the [[2020 NBA Bubble]] in [[Orlando, Florida|Orlando]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/los-angeles-lakers-win-nba-title-capping-league-s-coronavirus-n1242423 (NBC News)]
